free_tier_limits: 5,000 calls per day; limited to free consumer-facing applications.
rate_limits: Free plan: 5,000 calls per day. Premium includes high-volume usage, but its quota is not publicly quantified.
description: The Walk Score API returns Walk Score and optional Transit Score and Bike Score for supported locations in the United States and Canada. Real-estate sites and apps can use these scores to display, search, or rank properties by walkability and transportation access. Related premium APIs provide score details and public-transit data.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: corrected; the Free Version allows 5,000 calls/day for free consumer-facing applications (https://www.walkscore.com/professional/api-sign-up.php). rate_limits: corrected; that page publishes the 5,000/day quota. cors: corrected to no because official docs require server-side API calls (https://www.walkscore.com/professional/api.php). description: corrected; the Score API supports the US and Canada, returns the three scores, and does not document neighborhood details (https://www.walkscore.com/professional/api.php).
